One workspace, two ways in.

WhatsApp connects your team to FirmVault’s document workflow. The dashboard gives your firm a central view of its records.

WhatsApp assistant
Forward documents to FirmVault, supply their filing details and request a filed record when you need it.
FirmVault dashboard
View the firm’s document vault and the client, service, document type and period attached to each record.

Manage document access, review recorded activity and set retention for your firm.

Group and client access

Activity history

Encryption
Document data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
Document retention
Configure how long documents are retained for your firm.
